changed.title: One fan-in-two circuit reads a table at many input addresses with shared gates
changed.statement:
∀ (a b q : ℕ),
  let words := 2 ^ a
  let I := words * b + q * a
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (outBit : Fin q → Fin b → Fin (I + C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧ C.output < I + C.size ∧
    C.size ≤ 128 * (words + q) * (a + b + Nat.log2 (q + 1) + 3) ^ 3 ∧
    ∀ (table : Fin words → Fin b → Bool) (address : Fin q → Fin words),
      let x := (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin words => List.ofFn (table j))).flatten ++
        (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin q =>
          List.ofFn (fun i : Fin a => (address j).val.testBit i.val))).flatten
      ∀ (j : Fin q) (i : Fin b),
        (C.wires x).getD (outBit j i).val false = table (address j) i
changed.unlocks: supplies shared table lookups for a bank of ranked cyclic words
changed.context: On paper. Pad table records and query records to a power of two. Sort them with a bitonic network on dummy flag, address and tag, tables before requests. Keep each comparator's swap bit. Scan the sorted records, carrying the latest table word. Every real query now has its answer. Run the swaps backwards on those answers to restore query order, even at repeated addresses. Charge comparison, swaps in both directions, the scan and the shared constants.

changed.title: Majority of 8 bits (at least 4 on) has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 22 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 8 (fun x : Fin 8 → Bool => decide (4 ≤ (List.ofFn x).count true)) 22
changed.unlocks: a first rung below our own bar for this function
changed.context: Answer with a circuit, not an argument: a gate list (operation, wires read; wires 0 to n-1 are the input bits in the order the statement names, gate j writes wire n+j, each gate reads only earlier wires) and the output wire. Judged by one kernel evaluation over every input. Any search method is welcome; only the circuit is checked. The rung at 26 is checked; we do not hold that circuit. We do not know whether 22 exists. If your circuit uses a NOT gate, say so.

changed.title: A single cut trace recovers its cyclic pivots and certifies every later output to the left of a moving boundary
changed.statement:
∀ (k n : ℕ), 0 < n → 5 * n + 15 ≤ k →
  ∀ (cut : ℤ) (publicBit : ℕ → ℤ → Bool) (code : Fin (2 ^ n)),
  let mix := fun (word : ℤ → Bool) (z : ℤ) =>
    xor (xor (word z) (word (z - 1))) (word (z + 1))
  let before := fun (word : ℤ → Bool) (z : ℤ) =>
    xor (mix word z) (!(mix word (z + 1)) && mix word (z + 2))
  let state := fun (start : ℤ → Bool) (rounds : ℕ) =>
    (List.range rounds).foldl (fun (prev : ℤ → Bool) (tick : ℕ) (z : ℤ) =>
      xor (xor (before prev z) (start (z + 1 - 2 * (tick : ℤ)))) (publicBit (tick + 1) z)) start
  let residue := fun (z : ℤ) => (z % (k : ℤ)).toNat
  let periodic := fun (w : Fin (2 ^ k)) (p : ℤ) => w.val.testBit (residue p)
  let ones := fun (j : ℕ) => ((List.range j).filter (fun h => code.val.testBit h)).length
  let place := fun (j : ℕ) => cut - 3 * (5 + (j : ℤ)) + (ones j : ℤ)
  let pivot := fun (j : ℕ) => residue (cut + 5 - 5 * (5 + (j : ℤ)) + (ones j : ℤ))
  let realizesTrace := fun (w : Fin (2 ^ k)) => ∀ j < n,
    let z := state (periodic w) (4 + j)
    let a := place j
    xor (xor (z a) (z (a + 1))) (z (a + 2)) = code.val.testBit j
  (∀ seed : Fin (2 ^ k), ∃! w : Fin (2 ^ k), realizesTrace w ∧
    ∀ b < k, (∀ j < n, pivot j ≠ b) → w.val.testBit b = seed.val.testBit b) ∧
  ∀ w : Fin (2 ^ k), realizesTrace w → ∀ other : ℤ → Bool,
    (∀ z < cut, periodic w z = other z) →
    ∀ s : ℕ, n + 4 ≤ s → ∀ z : ℤ, z + 3 * (s : ℤ) < cut + (ones n : ℤ) →
      before (state (periodic w) (s - 1)) z = before (state other (s - 1)) z
changed.unlocks: Reconstructs the fixed transcript and certifies all later pre-injection outputs inside the moving boundary.
changed.context: After four rounds the words agree below H-12. At time t let a=H-3t+f. Below a all parents agree; at a only parent a+3 can differ. Its coefficient vanishes on parity one. Injections agree there. This advances the boundary by that answer. After n trials retreat three per later round. Each query reads J=H+5-5t+f once and otherwise only higher starts through H+f-1. These intervals nest, and the last has length 5n+15≤k. Successive J drop by four or five. Fix the nonpivots and solve the parities in time order. Later pivots leave every previous answer fixed.

changed.title: Four differences of a masked two-round cyclic update recover one mask bit times a determinant
changed.unlocks: identifies one mask coefficient that controls the two-round key-split and pin constraints
changed.context: Write the initial nonlinear output at s as affine terms plus z[s+1]z[s+2]. Only products of two quadratics survive four differences. All quartics from output t lie in a cyclic interval of span 2d+2. Since k exceeds twice that span, the designated extremes determine t=j. Only its two outer factors contain both extremes. Differencing them leaves the product of the two interior bits times m[j], up to affine terms. Polarize for the determinant. Gate-price companions cannot exist for this identity of Boolean derivatives because it has no object with a minimum circuit size.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 36247 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 10 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 5) => (36247 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 10
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 5 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 11 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out and equal gates merged); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 10; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 8 (on paper), a gap of 3. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 8 right, gate j writes wire 9 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 20 inputs with one vertex on each side.

changed.title: No AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 53 gates computes the edge function of the listed graph on 24 vertices with 44 edges
changed.unlocks: one search on a named graph: is there a circuit one gate smaller than the best we know for its edge function; a found circuit is a bound from above, a proof of none a bound from below
changed.context: SKETCH: truth not known to us; the opposite row is offered beside it. This side says the best circuit we know cannot be beaten by one gate: a finite search with a certificate the kernel replays, or an argument by restricting one vertex at a time down to smaller graphs whose sizes are checked. Size: unknown. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

changed.title: Rectangles: the 0-entries of a 31 by 31 0/1 matrix (rows in the sentence) are covered by at most 19 all-0 rectangles
changed.unlocks: one entry on how few one-colour rectangles cover the 0-entries or 1-entries of a named small matrix (plane incidence, inner product, a graph's complement): the cover number that communication bounds rest on
changed.context: SKETCH: truth not known to us; the opposite row is offered beside it. Proved by exhibiting the rectangles: a list of pairs (set of rows, set of columns), each all of the one colour, that together contain every entry of that colour; checked by evaluation over the matrix given in the sentence. Our best cover has one rectangle more than this row allows (computed, not checked), found by search and not by exhaustion. Size: minutes if such a cover exists. No sorry, no new axiom.
